text:
ella_support: Heads-up — Priority escalation from ACME (prod). They hit a big wave of 504s and timeouts hitting hosted inference at ~09:05 UTC. Customer says requests hang ~30s then gateway 504. They provided a repro curl and timestamps. Repro attached below.

ryan_oncall: I'm on it. Can you paste the gateway logs + any autoscaler events?

ella_support: Pasted, truncated: 
```
Gateway: 2026-03-15T09:05:12Z INFO request received tenant=acme id=...
Gateway: 2026-03-15T09:05:12Z ERROR downstream timeout after 30s status=504 route=/v1/generate
Queue: enqueue duration 120ms backlog=420
Controller: 2026-03-15T09:05:13Z INFO scaleup triggered for deployment=acme-models replicas:1->6 reason=queued_requests
KEDA: 2026-03-15T09:05:14Z WARN ScaledObject acme-inference: metric not found for 15s
Kubernetes: 2026-03-15T09:05:22Z INFO Pod acme-model-2 Container start; init took=18s
Runtime: model init=14s kv-cache coldstart
Gateway: 2026-03-15T09:05:45Z ERROR request timed out while waiting for replica ready
```

ella_support: Customer included a simple curl they ran (hits single-route, latency spike reproduces):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"model":"acme-13B","input":"hello"}' -v --max-time 35
```

sre_anya: Notes from infra after quick look: scaleup did start but pods stayed Pending/ContainerCreating for ~20-30s; readiness probe didn't pass until runtime finished model load. Meanwhile gateway keeps forwarding, causing queued requests to pile up and gateway 504. KEDA showed metric fluctuations because the external metric adapter (queue length) had a lag — annotation on scaledobject disables stabilisation?

ml_infra_pedro: Model cold-init is ~12-18s for that 13B quantized variant. We prewarm KV cache only on first inference. If scaled pods start concurrently, warmup overlaps with container init and readiness probe timeout settings matter.

ella_support: I inspected the ScaledObject YAML from the tenant namespace:
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: acme-inference
  annotations:
    keda.sh/enable-stabilization: "false"
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: acme-model-deployment
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prometheus.monitoring:9090
      metricName: queue_length
      threshold: "100"
  cooldownPeriod: "30"
  pollingInterval: "5"
```

ella_support: HPA on the same deployment exists but set with low cpu target and minReplicas=1. Looks like KEDA is the primary scaler.

ryan_oncall: Quick triage ideas: 1) temporary mitigation — bump minReplicas to 2-3 for this tenant to avoid coldstart thundering herd, 2) increase readinessProbe failureThreshold / initialDelay or set probe to check app up only after model init, 3) enable prewarm sidecar or a warmup command that runs immediately on start. Any objections?

ml_infra_pedro: Agree. Also we should reduce KEDA cooldown or enable stabilization (set enable-stabilization: true) so KEDA doesn't oscillate and misses metric windows. The ScaledObject annotation disabling stabilization looks suspicious — why was that set?

james_billing: Customer hit billing spike due to retries. We need to coordinate any changes; if we bump minReplicas we'll incur cost — advise CSM and offer credit if impacted SLA.

liam_csm: Noted. I'll message ACME and propose short mitigation (minReplicas=2) + postmortem. They want immediate fix.

sre_anya: Quick commands I ran: `kubectl get pods -n acme --show-labels` and `kubectl describe scaledobject acme-inference -n acme` — shows pollingInterval 5s but metrics pipeline from prometheus-to-keda had intermittent 15-25s delays due to scrape backlog. That means KEDA decision windows were missing spike onset.

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by ryan_oncall: bump acme-model-deployment minReplicas=3 (canary change) — CI checks OK.

ryan_oncall: Rolling this now. Will monitor queue/backlog and gateway 5xx. Also adding a temporary readinessProbe change: initialDelaySeconds 40 -> 60 to avoid marking not-ready prematurely.

ella_support: Customer confirms reduced 504s after 90s. They still saw small latency but no production outage anymore. ACME asked for root cause and repro.

ml_infra_pedro: Action items: 1) add a warmup hook for model runtime to mark readiness only after KV cache primed; 2) adjust scaledobject to enable stabilization and increase metric scrape reliability (longer retention + scrape backlog alert); 3) consider prewarmed standby replicas for large tenants or model families.

sre_anya: I'll open infra ticket to investigate Prometheus adapter lag and set an alert for scaledobject-metrics-latency >10s.

liam_csm: I'll draft customer note + credit proposal.

james_billing: Keep me in loop on any chargeback.

ryan_oncall: Leaving follow-ups for next shift: monitor for recurrence and rollback if cost becomes an issue. Closing P1 to incident channel but keeping ticket open until root cause fixes shipped. :white_check_mark:

ella_support: Thanks all. Saving reproducible steps in the support case and adding logs to incident ticket.
